## Data Exploration

This code is used to explore the counts, distributions, and so on of the data. This information will inform the Bayesian analysis and grant insights into how and where seagrass meadow OC stock data is collected.

```{r, echo = FALSE}

library(here)

dat <- read.csv(here("Data", "MetaAnalysis_SedCorgStockData.csv"))

speciesCount <- dat

head(dat)

```

## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
plot(pressure)
```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.
